projects.name: Stocks Visualizer
projects.summary: WebSocket based live stocks dashboard. Built with Python FastAPI and a JS+Vite+React frontend.
metrics: Real-time updates on a per-trade basis

projects.name: Intelligent API Scheduler
projects.summary: An asynchronous API scheduling service built with FastAPI and Python. The system manages API requests through a priority queue, token-bucket rate limiting, exponential-backoff retry policies, persistent job tracking, and a real-time WebSocket dashboard. Backend containerized in Docker.
metrics: Per-client retry policies and token bucketing

projects.name: Texas Hold'em Poker Bot
projects.summary: A web-scraper that reads the current poker game-state, evaluates the current position, calls an LLM for the optimal move, and drives the browser based on the LLMs response.
metrics: Sends witty quips on each turn

projects.name: Spotify Recommender
projects.summary: A vibe-coded Spotify app that has playback controls, a listening history, and a simple recommendation engine. Frontend in Vercel, backend deployed in Render, and uses Neon to host a Postgres database.
metrics: Live history generation with backfilling 'sync' option
Recommendation engine based on genre cosine similairities

projects.name: Digital Twin
projects.summary: An AI agent built to act as a digital twin of David Sweasey. Uses an OpenAI LLM to answer questions relating to his career, background, experience, and skills.
metrics: Rate limiting and caching for cost control
Sessions are saved for future reference

projects.name: Skin Cancer Classifier
projects.summary: A convolutional neural network built to classify skin cancer images. Trained on a 10,000 image dataset. Boasts a 90% accuracy, has visual metrics and a heat map.
projects.context: Class project for an AI course
metrics: Heat map for visualizing model focus

projects.name: Baseball Data Science
projects.summary: A data science project that uses a decision tree to predict how well a baseball team will perform based on recent historical data. The model uses player statistics and custom metrics to make its predictions.
projects.context: Class project for a data science course
metrics: Custom BAT_SCORE metric for player offensive performance
Intensive data cleaning, preprocessing, and feature engineering
projects.notes: This project was a team effort. I did most of the data cleaning, preprocessing, and feature engineering. I also implemented the decision tree model and created the BAT_SCORE metric.

projects.name: NCDIT Procurement Tracker
projects.summary: A full-stack application that tracks the status of a procurement project. It is displayed similarly to a pizza tracker, contains additional educational content, RBAC, and is built with Ruby on Rails.

projects.name: Personal Webpage
projects.summary: A personal webpage built with React and Vite. It is a single-page application that showcases my projects, skills, and experience. Connects to a Next.js backend for Spotify Now Playing data and a FastAPI backend that hosts the digital twin.
metrics: Connects to multiple backends for dynamic data

projects.name: FLUID
projects.summary: A full-stack form filling application with Agentic form-filling assistance. Built form-agnostic, so any form can be imported. The system is built with Power Pages, Power Automate, Dataverse, Azure OpenAI, and Azure Function Apps.
projects.context: Professional project while working at NCDIT
metrics: Built with Microsoft Power Platform and Azure services
projects.notes: Project built for NCDIT during my employment there.

projects.name: Form Builder Power App
projects.summary: A Power Apps application that allows users to build forms for the FLUID system. The app is built with Power Apps, Power Automate, and connects to Dataverse for data storage. Leverages the Adaptive Cards framework by Microsoft for form construction and rendering.
projects.role: Sole developer with guidance from the solutions architect
projects.context: Professional project while working at NCDIT
metrics: Connects to Dataverse for data storage
Leverages Adaptive Cards framework for form construction and rendering
Interacts with a separate form builder agent
projects.notes: Project built for NCDIT during my employment there. I was the sole developer, but received requirements from the solutions architect.
